message.content:
Hai! Saya belum bisa cek stok secara langsung, tapi biasanya “celana dalam 1 lusin ukuran L” memang tersedia di banyak toko.  
Apakah kamu ingin saya bantu cari toko online yang menjualnya, atau ada detail lain (misalnya merek, warna, atau harga) yang kamu butuhkan? Let me know!
message.reasoning: The user says: "Gan celana dalam 1 lusin ukuran L ready g gan???" This is Indonesian. They ask: "Gan celana dalam 1 lusin ukuran L ready g gan???" Means: "Bro, are there 1 dozen underwear size L ready?" They want to know if there's a dozen of size L underwear ready. They might be asking to purchase or check availability. We need to respond appropriately. We don't have inventory data. We can ask clarifying question or provide generic answer. We could say we don't have inventory but can check. Or we can ask for more details. We can also mention that we can't check inventory. We can ask if they want to place an order. We can respond politely.
